```{=html}
<!-- ===================================================================
     INTERACTIVE SCHEDULE
     Editing guide:
       - data-year on .mae-sched: the calendar year of the term's first
         class. Used for "Next class" and "Due in N days" badges.
       - Each <tr> takes data-date="MM/DD" (class meeting) and, optionally,
         data-due="MM/DD" (earliest deliverable deadline that week).
       - Rows with class="sched-event" are breaks / exam-period notices.
       - Cell classes (col-topic, col-blitz, col-spot, col-lab, col-due, col-span) drive the
         column toggles; data-label is the heading shown on phones.
     =================================================================== -->
<div class="mae-sched" data-year="2026">

  <style>
    .mae-sched {
      --s-accent: var(--bs-primary, #0d6efd);
      /* Derived from the text colour so light and dark Quarto themes both work */
      --s-border: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent);
      --s-muted: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 68%, transparent);
      --s-stripe: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 4%, transparent);
      --s-alert: var(--bs-danger, #dc3545);
      --s-bg: transparent;
      margin: 1.5rem 0;
      max-width: 100%;
      container-type: inline-size; /* layout follows the content column, not the window */
    }
    .mae-sched .sched-scroll { max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; }
    .mae-sched td { overflow-wrap: break-word; hyphens: auto; }
    .mae-sched input, .mae-sched button { -webkit-user-select: text; user-select: text; font: inherit; }

    /* ---------- toolbar ---------- */
    .mae-sched .sched-toolbar {
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .6rem 1rem; align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: .5rem;
    }
    .mae-sched .sched-search { flex: 1 1 16rem; margin: 0; }
    .mae-sched .sched-search input {
      width: 100%; padding: .45rem .7rem; border: 1px solid var(--s-border);
      border-radius: .375rem; background: var(--s-bg); color: inherit;
    }
    .mae-sched .sched-cols { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .mae-sched .sched-cols-label { color: var(--s-muted); font-size: .9em; margin-right: .15rem; }
    .mae-sched .sched-btn {
      border: 1px solid var(--s-border); background: transparent; color: inherit;
      padding: .3rem .7rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .9em; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .mae-sched .sched-btn[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--s-accent); border-color: var(--s-accent); color: #fff; }
    .mae-sched .sched-btn:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }
    .mae-sched .sched-jump { border-radius: .375rem; }
    .mae-sched .sched-check { display: inline-flex; gap: .4rem; align-items: center; font-size: .9em; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; }
    .mae-sched :is(input, button):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--s-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .mae-sched .sched-status { color: var(--s-muted); font-size: .85em; margin: 0 0 .5rem; min-height: 1.3em; }
    .mae-sched .sched-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }

    /* ---------- table ---------- */
    .mae-sched table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: .875em; }
    .mae-sched th, .mae-sched td { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--s-border); padding: .6rem .5rem; vertical-align: top; text-align: left; }
    .mae-sched thead th { border-bottom-width: 2px; background: var(--s-stripe); font-weight: 600; }
    .mae-sched tbody tr:nth-child(odd) { background: var(--s-stripe); }
    .mae-sched td ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 1.1rem; }
    .mae-sched td li + li { margin-top: .25rem; }
    .mae-sched td ul ul { margin-top: .2rem; }
    .mae-sched .col-week, .mae-sched .col-date { white-space: nowrap; }
    .mae-sched .wk-num { display: block; font-weight: 700; }
    .mae-sched .wk-range { display: block; color: var(--s-muted); font-size: .88em; }
    .mae-sched .sched-none { color: var(--s-muted); }
    /* minimum widths keep wide-table columns readable; table scrolls in place if the column is too narrow */
    .mae-sched .col-topic { min-width: 7em; }
    .mae-sched .col-blitz { min-width: 7em; }
    .mae-sched .col-spot { min-width: 9em; }
    .mae-sched .col-lab { min-width: 10em; }
    .mae-sched .col-due { min-width: 10em; }
    .mae-sched tr[hidden] { display: none !important; }
    .mae-sched.hide-topic .col-topic,
    .mae-sched.hide-blitz .col-blitz,
    .mae-sched.hide-spot .col-spot,
    .mae-sched.hide-lab .col-lab,
    .mae-sched.hide-due .col-due { display: none; }

    /* break / exam rows */
    .mae-sched .sched-event td { color: var(--s-alert); }
    .mae-sched .sched-event .col-span { font-weight: 600; }

    /* state */
    .mae-sched tr.is-past > td { opacity: .72; }
    .mae-sched tr.is-next { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--s-accent) 9%, transparent) !important; }
    .mae-sched tr.is-next > td:first-child { box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 var(--s-accent); }
    .mae-sched .sched-badge {
      display: inline-block; margin-top: .3rem; padding: .1rem .5rem; border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: .78em; font-weight: 600; background: var(--s-accent); color: #fff; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .mae-sched .sched-badge.due { background: transparent; color: var(--s-alert); border: 1px solid currentColor; margin: 0 0 .4rem; }
    .mae-sched mark.sched-hit { padding: 0 .1em; border-radius: .2em; background: #ffe066; color: #212529; }
    .mae-sched .sched-empty { padding: 1.5rem .6rem; text-align: center; color: var(--s-muted); }

    /* ---------- phones: each week becomes a card ---------- */
    @container (max-width: 760px) {
      .mae-sched table, .mae-sched tbody, .mae-sched td { display: block; width: 100%; }
      .mae-sched thead { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); }
      .mae-sched tbody tr {
        display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; margin-bottom: .9rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--s-border); border-radius: .5rem; overflow: hidden;
      }
      .mae-sched td { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--s-border); }
      .mae-sched td:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
      .mae-sched .col-week, .mae-sched .col-date { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--s-border); }
      .mae-sched .col-date { text-align: right; }
      .mae-sched .col-topic, .mae-sched .col-blitz, .mae-sched .col-spot, .mae-sched .col-lab, .mae-sched .col-due, .mae-sched .col-span { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      .mae-sched td.is-empty { display: none; }
      .mae-sched td[data-label]:not(.col-week):not(.col-date)::before {
        content: attr(data-label); display: block; font-weight: 600; font-size: .85em;
        color: var(--s-muted); margin-bottom: .3rem;
      }
      .mae-sched .wk-num, .mae-sched .wk-range { display: inline; margin-right: .4rem; }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
      .mae-sched tr.is-flash { animation: sched-flash 1.4s ease-out; }
      @keyframes sched-flash { from { outline: 3px solid var(--s-accent); } to { outline: 3px solid transparent; } }
    }

    @media print {
      .mae-sched .sched-toolbar, .mae-sched .sched-status { display: none; }
      .mae-sched tr[hidden] { display: table-row !important; }
      .mae-sched tr.is-past > td { opacity: 1; }
    }

  <script>
  (function () {
    var root = document.currentScript && document.currentScript.closest('.mae-sched');
    if (!root) root = document.querySelector('.mae-sched');
    if (!root || root.dataset.ready) return;
    root.dataset.ready = '1';

    var DAY = 864e5;
    var tbody = root.querySelector('tbody');
    var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(tbody.querySelectorAll(':scope > tr'));
    var spans = root.querySelectorAll('td.col-span');
    var search = root.querySelector('.sched-search input');
    var hidePast = root.querySelector('.sched-hide-past');
    var jumpBtn = root.querySelector('.sched-jump');
    var status = root.querySelector('.sched-status');
    var colBtns = root.querySelectorAll('[data-col]');

    /* ---- dates: MM/DD -> Date in the term's year; rolls into the next
           year if the semester crosses New Year (e.g. 12/xx -> 01/xx) ---- */
    var year = parseInt(root.dataset.year, 10) || new Date().getFullYear();
    var firstMonth = null;
    function parse(s) {
      if (!s) return null;
      var p = s.split('/').map(Number);
      if (firstMonth === null) firstMonth = p[0];
      var y = (p[0] < firstMonth - 5) ? year + 1 : year;
      return new Date(y, p[0] - 1, p[1]);
    }
    var today = new Date(); today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    var nextRow = null;
    rows.forEach(function (tr) {
      var d = parse(tr.dataset.date);
      tr._date = d;
      if (d && d < today) tr.classList.add('is-past');
      if (!nextRow && d && d >= today && !tr.classList.contains('sched-event')) nextRow = tr;
    });

    function badge(text, cls) {
      var b = document.createElement('span');
      b.className = 'sched-badge' + (cls ? ' ' + cls : '');
      b.textContent = text;
      return b;
    }

    if (nextRow) {
      nextRow.classList.add('is-next');
      var isToday = nextRow._date.getTime() === today.getTime();
      var cell = nextRow.querySelector('.col-date');
      cell.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));
      cell.appendChild(badge(isToday ? 'Today' : 'Next class'));
    } else {
      jumpBtn.disabled = true;
      jumpBtn.textContent = 'All classes completed';
    }

    /* "Due in N days" for deadlines within the next two weeks */
    rows.forEach(function (tr) {
      var due = parse(tr.dataset.due);
      var cell = tr.querySelector('.col-due');
      if (!due || !cell) return;
      var n = Math.round((due - today) / DAY);
      if (n < 0 || n > 14) return;
      var label = n === 0 ? 'Due today' : n === 1 ? 'Due tomorrow' : 'Due in ' + n + ' days';
      var b = badge(label, 'due');
      cell.insertBefore(document.createElement('br'), cell.firstChild);
      cell.insertBefore(b, cell.firstChild);
    });

    rows.forEach(function (tr) { tr._text = tr.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toLowerCase(); });

    /* ---- search highlighting ---- */
    function clearMarks() {
      root.querySelectorAll('mark.sched-hit').forEach(function (m) {
        m.replaceWith(document.createTextNode(m.textContent));
      });
      tbody.normalize();
    }
    function escapeRe(s) { return s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'); }
    function markRow(tr, re) {
      var walker = document.createTreeWalker(tr, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
        acceptNode: function (n) {
          if (!n.nodeValue.trim() || n.parentNode.closest('.sched-badge')) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
          return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
        }
      });
      var nodes = [];
      while (walker.nextNode()) nodes.push(walker.currentNode);
      nodes.forEach(function (node) {
        var text = node.nodeValue;
        re.lastIndex = 0;
        if (!re.test(text)) return;
        re.lastIndex = 0;
        var frag = document.createDocumentFragment(), last = 0, m;
        while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
          frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(last, m.index)));
          var mk = document.createElement('mark');
          mk.className = 'sched-hit';
          mk.textContent = m[0];
          frag.appendChild(mk);
          last = m.index + m[0].length;
        }
        frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(last)));
        node.replaceWith(frag);
      });
    }

    /* ---- empty state row ---- */
    var emptyRow = document.createElement('tr');
    emptyRow.hidden = true;
    var emptyCell = document.createElement('td');
    emptyCell.className = 'sched-empty';
    emptyCell.colSpan = 7;
    emptyRow.appendChild(emptyCell);
    tbody.appendChild(emptyRow);

    /* ---- filtering ---- */
    function apply() {
      var q = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      var re = q ? new RegExp(escapeRe(q), 'gi') : null;
      var shown = 0;
      clearMarks();
      rows.forEach(function (tr) {
        var ok = (!q || tr._text.indexOf(q) !== -1) &&
                 !(hidePast.checked && tr.classList.contains('is-past'));
        tr.hidden = !ok;
        if (ok) { shown++; if (re) markRow(tr, re); }
      });
      emptyRow.hidden = shown !== 0;
      if (!shown) {
        emptyCell.textContent = q
          ? 'No weeks match "' + search.value.trim() + '". Try a speaker, lab, or assignment number.'
          : 'Every week is in the past. Turn off "Hide past weeks" to see them.';
      }
      status.textContent = (q || hidePast.checked)
        ? 'Showing ' + shown + ' of ' + rows.length + ' entries'
        : '';
    }

    var timer;
    search.addEventListener('input', function () { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(apply, 120); });
    search.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') { search.value = ''; apply(); } });
    hidePast.addEventListener('change', apply);

    /* ---- column toggles ---- */
    function syncColumns() {
      var visible = 0;
      colBtns.forEach(function (b) {
        var on = b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true';
        root.classList.toggle('hide-' + b.dataset.col, !on);
        if (on) visible++;
      });
      spans.forEach(function (td) { td.colSpan = visible; });
      emptyCell.colSpan = 2 + visible;
    }
    colBtns.forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var on = b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true';
        var onCount = root.querySelectorAll('[data-col][aria-pressed="true"]').length;
        if (on && onCount === 1) return; /* keep at least one column */
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'false' : 'true');
        syncColumns();
      });
    });

    /* ---- jump to next class ---- */
    jumpBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (!nextRow) return;
      if (nextRow.hidden) { search.value = ''; hidePast.checked = false; apply(); }
      var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
      nextRow.scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      nextRow.classList.remove('is-flash');
      void nextRow.offsetWidth;
      nextRow.classList.add('is-flash');
    });

    syncColumns();
    apply();
  })();
  </script>
</div>
```
